text: mara-marketing: Hey folks  small last-minute ask for the launch narrative on semantic search. Can eng/runtime validate the webinar embedding bundle at s3://redwood-prod/benchmarks/embeds/launch/2026-03/ with a focus on: (1) embedding median + p95 latency (per-item), (2) batch throughput at batch sizes [1,8,32], (3) cosine recall @10 vs float when using 8-bit quantized embeddings, and (4) the end-to-end query->retrieve latency when coupled with a simple FAISS recall (we have a FAISS docker harness). Target: 600 samples for main run, plus a 100-sample batch-scaling sweep. Need raw CSVs, a small slide PNG, and a 1-paragraph methods blurb. Also include machine/runtime tags. Can you do this today? :pray:
mara-marketing_followup: mara-marketing: For the recall measurement, please report recall@10 and mean reciprocal rank (MRR) on a held-out 100 sample set. Also note whether we used L2 vs cosine in the methods blurb.
samir-eng-runtime:
Ack. We'll run embedding smoke + batch sweep. Two experiments: (A) single-item latency + p95 on float32/8bit, (B) batch throughput at sizes 1,8,32 measuring avg tokens/sec per GPU. For recall we'll compute cosine similarity against a prebuilt FAISS index (IVF10) in the harness. We'll also output a top10-quant-affected.csv for comms review. Repro command I plan to run:

`````
# embed smoke + batch sweep
tools/bench/run_embed_smoke.sh 
  --s3 s3://redwood-prod/benchmarks/embeds/launch/2026-03/ 
  --samples 600 
  --batch-sweep 1,8,32 
  --model redwood-embed-v2 
  --quantized both 
  --index faiss:/mnt/faiss/index_ivf10.faiss 
  --recall-heldout 100 
  --truncate 4096 
  --output gs://bench-results/embeds/1956604321/
`````

Note: I'll run a separate 100-sample micro-sweep specifically to measure batch scaling on an A100 and an A40 to show hardware differences.
lee-eng-runtime: One gotcha: some embedding shards include metadata fields that break the CSV->jsonl converter (we've seen nested metadata). We'll detect and drop those rows and include counts. Also for 8-bit quantized embeddings we run symmetric quant followed by a recalibration step; that'll be in methods.md. We'll cap vectors to 2048 dims if necessary and emit vector_dim in the CSV.
olivia-data: For recall validation please use the labeled nearest neighbors in the shard (field: ground_truth_ids). If missing, drop and count them. Also please compute recall both before and after L2-normalization so we can sanity-check cosine handling.
[~90m later] samir-eng-runtime_update: Run finished. Uploaded artifacts to gs://bench-results/embeds/1956604321/{embed-600.csv, batch-sweep-100.csv, recall-heldout-100.csv, top10-quant-affected.csv, methods.md, slide-summary.png}. Highlights: single-item median latency (float) = 9ms, p95 = 28ms; single-item median latency (8-bit) = 6ms, p95 = 22ms. Batch throughput (items/sec/GPU) median at batch=1/8/32 (float) = [110, 780, 2400]; 8-bit = [160, 1200, 3700] respectively. Recall@10 (float) = 0.91, Recall@10 (8-bit) = 0.89; MRR@10 float=0.73, 8-bit=0.71. Dropped_rows_schema=6/600, truncated_rows=1/600. Vector_dim=1024 for all samples.
lee-eng-runtime_followup: Also ran hardware comparison micro-sweep: A40 batch=32 float throughput 2200 items/sec, A100 3700 items/sec (quantized). Added hardware notes to methods.md: runtime=redwood-runtime v2.2.1, CUDA 12.2, cuDNN 9.x, A100-80GB and A40 pools used. Quantization = symmetric 8-bit with calibration on heldout-200.
henry-legal: Legal note: we're fine publishing these internal benchmarks if methods.md includes sample size, machine types, and a short caveat: 'Internal benchmark on representative samples; actual product performance may vary by workload and deployment.' Please add that sentence.
mara-marketing_closing: Perfect  this is great for the slide. Two tiny asks: (1) can you add a one-row CSV with: sample_count, median_embed_float, p95_embed_float, median_embed_8bit, p95_embed_8bit, recall10_float, recall10_8bit, mrr10_float, mrr10_8bit, a40_vs_a100_speedup_at32, dropped_pct? (2) confirm we can publish recall numbers as 'internal benchmark: embedding recall' with the legal caveat.
samir-eng-runtime_final: Added slide-table.csv and updated methods.md with the legal caveat. Permission confirmed by eng + legal to publish as 'internal benchmark: embedding recall' with methods footnote. All artifacts in the bucket. Marking thread resolved unless marketing wants additional checks. :white_check_mark:
